title: The Yellow Wallpaper
author: Charlotte Perkins Gilman
summary: A woman ordered to rest in a nursery room by her physician husband becomes more and more fixated on its patterned yellow wallpaper, in a story told through her secret journal.
readIf: you want a short, unsettling classic about confinement and control.
skipIf: you prefer stories with clear answers and a lot of action.
